reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No duplication; every consumer in the tree already reads the expected amount through getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The rule lives in its shared definition in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the two expressions of the rule and the matching tests change.

maintainability.why: The new rule ('lowest value allowed') is expressed directly as min / minus threshold, simpler than before.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All callers (forecast, schedules app, schedule template, API, preview, client components) use getScheduledAmount.
